$comment: The arc reactor as an instrument (Reactor II, the C2 reactor reference): one geometry on every surface. Radii are fractions of R, the drawable radius (half the size minus a 4px margin). Read by aura-web/src/lib/reactor/reactor.test.ts against Reactor.svelte; the phone's ReactorOrb.kt and android-app/tools/reactor_orb_test.py follow in wave 2, so the two renderers cannot drift by being retuned in step by hand. Periods are named tokens in design/tokens.json (motion.reactor.*), not seconds, because a duration is a design value. The states are tests/contracts/reactor.json's eleven; the instrument wears them as colour and motion (Reactor.svelte's header says how), never as a different picture.

instrument.$comment: The flat instrument's marks that are neither a radius nor a state: Reactor.svelte's (and the C2 reactor reference's) opacities, the glint's keyframes, the core lens's gradient stops, the level arc's glow and the margin round the bezel. Widths, radii and minimums in `blade_width_min`, `level_width`, `dot_min`, `dot_glow_min`, `level_glow` and `margin` are SVG px on the web and dp on the phone.

wear.$comment: What the flat instrument wears in each of reactor.json's eleven states: the same picture every time, told apart by colour and motion. `live` is what is lit now (the level arc, the core's rim, the glint, the dot's halo); `hot` the dot itself; `rim` and `think` the opacity of the core's rim and of the dashed thinking ring; `dim` the whole instrument's opacity; `glow` how the dot's halo moves: steady; `beat` (motion.dur.pulse, there and back: the voice); `call` (motion.dur.enter, there and back: the microphone is open); `held` (reactor.json attention: rise over motion.dur.pulse, hold, fall, on motion.dur.blink); `flash` (reactor.json alert: three motion.dur.pulse cycles, then held lit). The columns are Reactor.svelte's CSS; attention and alert take reactor.json's own motions where the web pulses both on motion.dur.enter. Read by the phone's reactor/Instrument.kt through android-app/tools/reactor_instrument_test.py; Reactor.svelte types the same values in its stylesheet and is not held to this table yet.
